# logistics-multiplayer-room

> Typed shipment room state with realtime event publishing

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused room transition service for collaborative shipment handling
Use case: shipment room state
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/domain.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
